address: Hoar Cross Hall, Maker Ln, Burton upon Trent, Burton-on-Trent,DE13 8QS
bio: Indulge in Afternoon Tea at Hoar Cross Hall. Set within 43 acres of historic woodland in Staffordshire, this is a stunning setting to enjoy Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is served in the old Library which is a historic room, featuring contemporary furnishings against an oak-panelled backdrop.  The menu features a variety of savoury items alongside freshly baked scones and delectable sweet treats. This is paired with a selection of loose leaf teas and infusions. Guests have the option of upgrading their Afternoon Tea with a glass of Prosecco or Champagne.  Hoar Cross Hall is set within picturesque gardens in Staffordshire, a short distance from Burton-On-Trent train station.
